review_candidates.title: DAM Sales Executive
review_candidates.description: Join Us At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact. Role Purpose The DAM Sales Executive role at Vodafone Egypt is mainly to drive sales growth and expand Vodafone’s market share across assigned regional territories, within Vodafone Business / enterprise accounts while meeting customer excellence standards. DAM Sales Executive is responsible for ensuring that SME/SOHO Account management channel is meeting customer excellence standards while Create a visible step change versus our competition to gain market share. Job Profile Managing a group of accounts to work on achieving Net adds, Voice points, solution and accounts targets Growing revenue by selling Vodafone’s telecom and digital solutions Building strong client relationships with business customers and key stakeholders Identifying new business opportunities and winning new accounts Coordinating with internal teams like Marketing, Activation, IT, and Operations to execute projects smoothly Ensuring customer excellence & handling by resolving issues quickly and improving customer satisfaction/NPS Monitoring performance and reporting on sales progress, account health, and market opportunities Ensuring the quality of Sales Competencies & Qualifications Having Experience in telecom & technology industries Sales/account management experience Negotiation and communication skills Commercial awareness Full awareness of Vodafone Business Digital Solutions Territory management capability Strong stakeholder management and reporting skills Reporting, time management & presentation skills Results oriented, self-disciplined and organized spoken & written English language Having 4+ years of Sales & Outdoor Sales Who We Are We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same. Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You'll be part of a global and diverse community, with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. ;We're committed to increase diversity, ensure equal representation, and make Vodafone a place everyone feels safe, valued and included. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, please refer to https://careers.vodafone.com/application-adjustments/ for guidance. Together we can.

review_candidates.title: Automation Tester
review_candidates.description: Company Description Amjaad Technology is a leading corporation in IoT and utility management, delivering smart metering solutions for electricity, water, BTU, and gas across the region. Through its innovative ioMeter System, the company enables utility service providers, real estate developers, and smart cities to drive digital transformation, optimize energy use, and support sustainability goals. Amjaad Technology also develops platforms for community and facilities management in smart cities, enhancing efficiency, resource utilization, and operational workflows. With more than 300 projects completed in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, its solutions have positively impacted over 200,000 people. Applicants join a growing organization focused on scalable technology and sustainable communities. Role Description The Automation Tester role is a full-time, on-site position based in Qesm El Maadi. The Automation Tester will design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web and backend systems, ensuring the reliability and performance of Amjaad Technology’s IoT and utility management platforms. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing requirements, creating and executing test cases, performing API and integration testing, and documenting test results and defects in a clear and structured manner. The role involves close collaboration with developers, product teams, and quality assurance colleagues to identify issues early, refine test strategies, and support continuous improvement of the software development lifecycle. The Automation Tester will also contribute to test framework enhancements and help standardize testing practices across projects. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Quality Assurance skills, including understanding of QA methodologies and defect lifecycle. Candidates should possess Manual Testing and Test Cases skills, including test planning, execution, and reporting. Candidates should possess API Testing skills, including experience with tools such as Postman, REST clients, or similar. Candidates should possess Automation skills, including experience with test automation frameworks and scripting languages (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar). Relevant experience in testing web applications, backend services, or IoT-related platforms is beneficial. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a structured approach to testing. Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and document findings comprehensively. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Familiarity with CI/CD tools, version control (e.g., Git), and Agile or Scrum development environments is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer II, Foundation
review_candidates.description: Platform Engineering at Chainalysis provides the shared infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience layer that powers every engineering team. We are moving away from team-owned infrastructure silos and consolidating onto shared, scalable platform patterns. The Foundation discipline owns the substrate: cloud infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, streaming, and security primitives. Everything else runs on what we build. We are hiring a Software Engineer II to join the Foundation team. Your job is straightforward: build, improve, and operate the infrastructure primitives that every service at Chainalysis depends on — Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, streaming infrastructure (Kafka / WarpStream), secrets management, IAM, and the reconcilers that make it all self-service and drift-free. This is an infrastructure-focused IC role at the C4 level, typically suited for someone with 3–5 years of experience. You will work alongside senior engineers who will pair with you, review your work, and invest in your growth. You will report to the Senior Manager of Platform Engineering. In This Role, You'll Build and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Terraform — designing the modules and patterns that provision the substrate our services run on, and thinking beyond the immediate use case to how your work is consumed across the organization Operate and evolve multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters (EKS) serving the entire engineering organization — owning node lifecycle, upgrades, security contexts, and networking decisions that affect every team Own the operational side of our streaming infrastructure migration from managed Kafka (MSK) to WarpStream, building and maintaining the tooling that supports it Contribute to platform tooling and reconcilers that underpin our platform contract model — writing Go, working with the Kubernetes API, and building high-quality self-service primitives that engineering teams rely on to declare what their services need Design and maintain foundational networking and security infrastructure — transit gateways, GCP interconnect, ingress, security groups, IAM policies, and IRSA — getting the invisible plumbing right so nobody has to think about it Participate in on-call rotations and drive operational excellence — responding to infrastructure incidents, writing and improving runbooks, and feeding every incident pattern back into automation so the same class of issue never repeats We're Looking For Candidates Who Have 3+ years of software engineering or infrastructure engineering experience Hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, VPC, or similar) — we're looking for people who have built and operated real infrastructure, not certifications Working knowledge of Kubernetes in production — you have operated or deployed workloads on K8s clusters beyond a local environment Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform strongly preferred; Pulumi or CloudFormation acceptable) Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, or shell scripting — Go is preferred because our reconciler work is in Go, but you should be ready to turn your hand to whatever the problem demands Comfort with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Argo, Jenkins, or similar) and hands-on experience with on-call and incident response — you understand what it means to be accountable for production systems You Might Also Have Experience building Kubernetes operators or controllers — CRDs, reconcilers, and the controller-runtime library Familiarity with streaming infrastructure (Kafka, WarpStream, or similar event-driven systems) or depth in networking (VPCs, transit gateways, ingress controllers, DNS, load balancing, and security groups) Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO-27001, or similar compliance frameworks) or familiarity with GitOps patterns (ArgoCD, Flux) A passion for platform engineering as leverage — you care about making other engineers more productive, and when you see toil, your instinct is to eliminate it Technologies We Use Languages: Go, Python, Bash/Shell, HCL (Terraform) Cloud: AWS (EC2, EKS, IAM, S3, VPC, Lambda), GCP Infrastructure as Code: Terraform Kubernetes: EKS, Helm, CRDs, controller-runtime Streaming: Kafka, WarpStream (migrating from MSK) Networking: Transit Gateway, GCP Interconnect, Ingress Controllers, DNS, Security Groups Identity & Security: IAM, IRSA, Secrets Management CI/CD: GitHub Actions GitOps: ArgoCD, Flux AI at Chainalysis AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it. AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before. About Chainalysis Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation. You belong here. At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture. We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.
